sources.snippet: About this model FLUX.2-flex is a professional text-to-image generation and image editing model specialized for typography and fine detail preservation. Built on latent flow matching with a rectified flow transformer architecture, it provides adjustable inference steps (up to 50) and guidance scale (1.5-10) for fine-grained control over the diffusion process.
